description_en: Cī Bāhāḥ Nani is located to the east of the street that runs from Cyāsala to Olakhu. It is known as Ci Bāhāḥ Libi (a courtyard with acaitya) amongt the local residents. The main facade of the structure has two columns that support a door screen between them. The door has atoraṇaabove it and a metal screen to protect the image housed inside the sanctum. The roof has a plastered coping on the boundary wall and a small pinnacle. A cornice band runs along the boundary wall. Although Nanis are often associated with their main Bāhāḥs, this Nani has no association with any other major Bāhāḥ. It solely belongs to the Prajāpati family.Locke(1985, 72) assumes that Nani's present shrine was constructed after the 1934 earthquake. The shrine lacks many major features that are typical to abāhāḥ.The main shrine is attached to a boundary wall on the south. The sanctum holds a north-facing stone statue of Akṣobhya wearing alhegā(metal attire). Following the theft of the original statue a few years ago, this new statue is now protected by a metal grill. Broken pieces of glass have been embedded in the boundary wall for further protection. Above the door, one can find atoraṇawith a lotus petal in its centre. A stone relief depicting the Five Buddhas is placed underneath the image of Akṣobhya. The inscription on the pedestal of these images is now illegible. Images of Nārāyaṇa, Vajradhara, Mañjuśrī, Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara, Gaṇeśa, and Mahākāla have been placed in a line on the wall. Outside, a Śikharakūṭa Caitya sits in front of the main shrine. The courtyard is paved with concrete tiles. The earliest inscription mentioning this Nani is dated to NS 796.
description_ne: ओलखु टोलको चौबाटोमा रहेको गणेश मन्दिरको उत्तपट्टिको बाटो भएर च्यासलतिर जाँदा बाटोको पूर्वमा यो विहार रहेको छ । यो विहार खुल्ला ठाउँमा नभई निजी घरको चोकभित्र रहेको छ । यो कुनै मूल विहारको शाखा विहार नभई प्रजापतिहरूको स्वतन्त्र निजी विहार हो । स्थानीयहरू यसलाई विहार नभनी चिभा: लिबि (चैत्य रहेको चोक) भन्ने गर्छन् । सन् १९३४ को भूकम्पभन्दा अघि यो ठाउँ विहारकै स्वरूपमा थियो (Locke 1985, 72) तर अहिले विहारमा देखिने विशेषता यहाँ देखिँदैन । घरको चोकभित्र दक्षिण दिशामा प्लाष्टर गरिएको सानो मन्दिर रहेको छ । यो मन्दिरमा उत्तराभिमुख गरी विहारको क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्य राखिएको छ । बुद्धको शरीरमा धातुको ल्हेगाले छोपिएको छ । केही वर्ष अगाडि पुरानो मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि नयाँ मूर्ति बनाएर स्थापना गरिएको हो । क्वा:पा:द्य:लाई फलामको ढोका बनाई सुरक्षा दिइएको छ । फलामको ढोकामाथि राखिएको काठको तोरणमा कुनै देवता राखिएको छैन । क्वा:पा:द्य: रहेको भागको मुनि पञ्चबुद्धको ढुंगाको मूर्ति लहरै राखिएको छ । मूर्तिको पादपीठमा अभिलेख कुँदिएको छ । अभिलेख अपूर्ण रहेकोले पूर्ण विवरण बुझिंदैन । मन्दिरको माथि प्लाष्टर गरी छाना राखिएको छ । छानामाथि ढुंगाकै गजूर राखिएको छ । विहारको सुरक्षाको लागि मन्दिरको छाना र दक्षिणतिको पर्खालमा शीशाका टुक्राहरू राखिएका छन् । विहार परिसरमा एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य रहेको छ ।यो विहार कहिले निर्माण गरियो भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने अभिलेख पाईँदैन । यहाँ पाइएको सबभन्दा पुरानो अभिलेख नेसं ७९६ को हो जसमा विहारमा धार्मिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न गुठी जग्गा राखेको वर्णन परेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription is on the base of the Pañca Buddha statues, beneath theesoteric deity(kvāḥpāḥdyaḥ). It is fragmented, and so the date and event is not clearly readable. The inscription mentions that Viso Siṃ was a caretaker. It also mentions that everyone must respect the wishes of the donors. It states that any act contrary to their wishes would be sinful and equivalent to killing a Brāhmaṇa.
Land was endowed by Kamarāma Prajāpati to perform ritual activities.
